theorem lg_target (c : ℝ) : (fun x => Real.log (x * c)) =O[Filter.atTop] Real.log := by
  have h : ∀ᶠ x in Filter.atTop, 0 < x * c := by
    filter_right (λ x, 0 < x) (λ x, 0 < c)
  filter_map h
  refine (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop _).trans _
  exact isLittleO_const_log_atTop
  exact isLittleO_log_id_atTop
